summary: Broadstone Net Lease, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of 11,000,000 common shares (up to 12,650,000 with underwriters' option) via forward sale agreements with Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan. The REIT will not receive initial proceeds; it expects physical settlement by September 30, 2027, at an initial forward sale price based on the $21.20 per share August 5, 2026 close. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: settlement mechanics and potential dilution timing.
